name: Luke the Evangelist (of the Seventy)
life: The Holy Apostle and Evangelist Luke was a physician from Syrian Antioch and one of the Seventy Disciples. A companion of the Apostle Paul, he authored the Gospel of Luke and the Acts of the Apostles. Tradition holds that he painted the first icon of the Theotokos, who blessed it saying: 'Let the grace of He born of Me and My mercy be with these icons.' He preached in Achaia, Libya, Egypt, and the Thebaid, where he suffered martyrdom.
